description: Android Activity class 'NewLocaleDialog' that displays a dialog for the user to input a locale string (e.g., 'en_US') and returns the input via an Intent with extras indicating the locale value and if it was selected.

classes.name: NewLocaleDialog
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a dialog to input a locale string and returns the result via intent extras.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created, sets up the UI elements and click listeners.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button click events, retrieves locale input, determines if the 'select' button was clicked, logs the info if debugging is enabled, and returns the data via an intent.
